title: Whatever Happens in the Markets
goal: Express unconditional policy commitments with reduplicated subjunctives and economic collocations.
grammar: reduplicated subjunctive formulas and support-verb collocations

items: I can use reduplicated subjunctive formulas such as *pase lo que pase*, *cueste lo que cueste* and *digan lo que digan* in economic commentary.
I can match *sea cual sea* and *sean cuales sean* to singular and plural nouns.
I can use economic support-verb collocations (*tomar medidas*, *poner en marcha*, *llevar a cabo*, *dar lugar a*) accurately.
